name: URINE FOR KETONE BODIES (Acetone)
description: Urine Ketone Bodies detects acetoacetic acid and acetone in urine and evaluates diabetic ketoacidosis, starvation ketosis, and metabolic disorders. This test monitors ketone production in carbohydrate-restricted states.
literatureReview: Urine Ketone Bodies detects acetoacetic acid and acetone produced during fat metabolism. Normal: negative. Positive in diabetic ketoacidosis, starvation, low-carb diets, pregnancy, and alcoholic ketoacidosis. Dipstick method uses sodium nitroprusside reaction. Semi-quantitative: trace, small, moderate, large. Most sensitive for acetoacetic acid, less for acetone. Used in DKA monitoring, dietary ketosis assessment, and metabolic disorder evaluation. False negatives with ascorbic acid. Should be confirmed with blood ketones in suspected DKA. Critical for diabetes management and metabolic monitoring.
